## My request:
How would I run this ?
I’ll check the published commands and your local build paths so I can give you an exact invocation.
The environment preflight still flags changed setup fingerprints. I’ll verify the installed imports and script entry point directly.

The adapter and DD4hep model are already built on this machine. Run:

```sh
source [redacted]
acts run acts-nodd

export NODD_PATH=[redacted]

python [redacted] \
  --nodd-dir "$NODD_PATH" \
  --output "$NODD_PATH/build/gen3-local" \
  --tracks 128
```

This constructs the complete Gen3 geometry and propagates 128 seeded straight tracks. Expect **45,646 sensitive surfaces and 117 volumes**.

Output in `$NODD_PATH/build/gen3-local`:

- `surfaces.json`: sensor identities, transforms, bounds and volumes.
- `summary.root`: propagation summaries.
- `steps.root`: individual propagation steps.

For **Geant4 material recording through the full DD4hep model**, use:

```sh
python [redacted] \
  --nodd-dir "$NODD_PATH" \
  -n 1 -t 100 --seed 228 \
  -o "$NODD_PATH/build/material-local/nodd_tracker"
```

That produces `nodd_tracker.root`. The Gen3 navigation example uses straight tracks without a magnetic field.
